headline: Profit rebounds sequentially, still trails last year
summary_short: Equity Residential's Q2 FY2026 diluted EPS was $0.30, up 25.0% q/q but down 40.0% y/y, as net income of $114.1M rose 26.7% sequentially yet fell 40.7% from a year ago.
summary_long: Diluted EPS of $0.30 rose 25.0% q/q but fell 40.0% y/y. Revenue of $785.0M grew 0.7% q/q and 2.1% y/y. Operating income of $218.9M rose 2.4% q/q but was down 3.2% y/y; EBITDA of $452.5M rose 6.8% q/q yet fell 13.6% y/y. Net income of $114.1M rose 26.7% q/q but declined 40.7% y/y, and pretax income of $120.5M followed the same pattern (+26.1% q/q, -41.0% y/y). Total cash of $36.4M rose 5.0% q/q and 16.4% y/y. Shareholders' equity of $10,515.0M fell 1.5% q/q and 4.5% y/y. Weighted diluted shares of 383.9M declined 0.3% q/q and 1.9% y/y.
